meta_title: Fast Car Keys | Car Locksmith Leeds
meta_description: Fast Car Keys in Leeds provides emergency car key replacement, lock repairs, and vehicle access solutions. Same-day service available. Call now for rapid help.
hero_subhead: Lost your keys at midnight? We're here in under an hour, any time of day or night. Fast, honest rates.
services_subhead: From emergency unlock to replacement keys and ignition repair, we handle all vehicle access issues quickly and professionally.

services.title: Emergency Car Unlock
services.desc: Locked out with no spare key? We'll open your car safely without damage. Fast response, day or night.

services.title: Car Key Replacement
services.desc: Lost or broken keys? We cut and programme new keys on-site for most makes and models, including modern transponder keys.

services.title: Ignition Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Worn ignition cylinder or stuck key? We repair or replace your ignition and supply a new set of keys to match.

services.title: Lock Repair & Rekeying
services.desc: Faulty door lock or damaged mechanism? We repair, rekey, or replace car door locks to get you back on the road.

services.title: Spare Key Cutting
services.desc: Need an extra key for peace of mind? We cut spare keys and programme them for your vehicle on the spot.

services.title: Vehicle Access Services
services.desc: Broken window, jammed lock, or lost fob? We handle all access issues with minimal fuss and no unnecessary damage.

about_pullquote: We started this because we hated seeing people gouged for a simple unlock.
about_para_1: Fast Car Keys has been rescuing locked-out drivers across Leeds and the surrounding region for over 12 years. Started as a one-man operation, we've grown to a trusted team because we deliver what we promise: honest prices, rapid response, and professional workmanship. Every call gets the same care, whether it's midnight or Monday morning.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we don't trick them into unnecessary repairs or charge panic prices for emergencies. We carry the tools and blanks needed for most vehicles and can cut and programme new keys on your driveway. You won't find any hidden charges—just straightforward help when you need it most.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Drivers Say About Fast Car Keys

reviews.text: Locked myself out of my Audi on the motorway near Leeds. Phoned in complete panic and the lad was there in less than an hour. Sorted the lot in ten minutes, new key and everything. Couldn't fault him, really reasonable charge too. Top marks.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had lost my car keys somewhere between home and work. Called Fast Car Keys on a Friday afternoon and expected to wait days for a replacement. They came out same day, cut me a new key in the driveway and it worked perfectly. Absolute lifesaver, will definitely keep their number.
reviews.author: Emma H.

reviews.text: My ignition had finally given up the ghost. Got quoted £800 at the main dealer. Fast Car Keys sorted me for less than half that and fitted it in two hours. Honest bloke, knows his stuff, and didn't try to sell me anything I didn't need. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.
